fonts.display: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Reckless', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Forest Ink
palette.role: Primary brand color, header background, nav bar fill, section dividers, footer — deep teal-green against warm cream creates agricultural gravitas

palette.name: Vivid Lime
palette.role: Promotional marquee strip, highlight announcement bars, occasional link hover wash — the only high-energy accent in the palette

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Page canvas, base background — warm off-white replacing pure white to feel organic and printed

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Card surfaces, input fills, button text, icon backgrounds — the bright counterpoint against bone canvas

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Secondary card surface, subtle section dividers

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Primary body text, headings on light, icon strokes — near-black for high contrast on cream

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary text, link borders, button borders, subdued UI outlines

palette.name: Pewter
palette.role: Muted helper text, tertiary button text and borders

palette.name: Sky Card
palette.role: Decorative card surface — one of the quilted pastel tiles used for partner testimonials and category blocks

palette.name: Peach Card
palette.role: Decorative card surface — warm pastel tile alternating with sky and sage cards

palette.name: Sage Card
palette.role: Decorative card surface — soft green pastel tile for agrarian category blocks

palette.name: Moss
palette.role: Subtle borders, input outlines, decorative dividers within body content
